Courtney Love | Courtney Michelle Love (born Courtney Michelle Harrison; July 9, 1964) is an American singer, songwriter, actress, and visual artist.  Prolific in the punk and grunge scenes of the 1990s, Love has enjoyed a career that spans four decades.  She rose to prominence as the frontwoman of the alternative rock band Hole, which she formed in 1989.  Love has drawn public attention for her uninhibited live performances and confrontational lyrics, as well as her highly publicized personal life following her marriage to Kurt Cobain.
